records.jp: こころってキャンプしたことある？
records.en_original: Have you ever gone camping before, Kokoro?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you ever gone camping before, Kokoro?
records.en: Have you ever gone camping before, Kokoro?

records.jp: うーんと……ちっちゃいころに家族で何度か。<CR>愛央ちゃんは？
records.en_original: Umm, I went a few times with my family when I was little. Have you?
records.en_auxiliary: Umm, I went a few times with my family when I was little. Have you?
records.en: Hmm... I went a few times with my family when I was little.<CR>What about you, Ao-chan?

records.jp: 私も家族で一、二回あったかなあ。<CR>でも、キャンプも色々大変だよね
records.en_original: I went once or twice with the family. It's pretty rough, don't you think?
records.en_auxiliary: I went once or twice with the family. It's pretty rough, don't you think?
records.en: I went once or twice with my family too.<CR>But camping is difficult in all sorts of ways.

records.jp: やっぱ自然の中だと、虫とかいっぱいいるしさ
records.en_original: Like, when you're in the middle of nature like this, there are bugs everywhere.
records.en_auxiliary: Like, when you're in the middle of nature like this, there are bugs everywhere.
records.en: Like, when you're in the middle of nature like this, there are bugs everywhere.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、虫苦手？
records.en_original: You don't like bugs, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't like bugs, Ao?
records.en: You don't like bugs, Ao-chan?

records.jp: あまり触りたくはないかなあ。<CR>こころは平気そう
records.en_original: I definitely prefer to avoid them if I can. You seem like you wouldn't mind them.
records.en_auxiliary: I definitely prefer to avoid them if I can. You seem like you wouldn't mind them.
records.en: I definitely prefer to avoid them if I can. You seem<CR>like you wouldn't mind them.

records.jp: うん、まあ。<CR>特別好きでもないけど、そんなに苦手じゃないかも
records.en_original: I suppose. I can't say I really like them, but I don't hate them either.
records.en_auxiliary: I suppose. I can't say I really like them, but I don't hate them either.
records.en: I suppose.<CR>I can't say I really like them, but I don't hate them either.

records.jp: あ、愛央ちゃん。手のとこに虫……
records.en_original: Oh, Ao. There's a bug on your hand.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, Ao. There's a bug on your hand.
records.en: Oh, Ao-chan. There's a bug on your hand.

records.jp: わーっ！　とって！　とって！
records.en_original: Ahh! Get it off! Get it off!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh! Get it off! Get it off!
records.en: Ahh! Get it off! Get it off!

records.jp: 熊とか出たら怖いしね。<CR>熊に会ったらどうするんだっけ？　死んだふり？
records.en_original: I'm always scared the bears will appear out of nowhere. What are you supposed to do again? Play dead?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm always scared the bears will appear out of nowhere. What are you supposed to do again? Play dead?
records.en: I'm always scared the bears will<CR>appear out of nowhere. What are you supposed to do again? Play dead?

records.jp: 死んだふりって意味ないって聞いたことあるよ。<CR>エサだと思って、逆に近づいてきちゃうとか
records.en_original: I've heard that it's no use playing dead. They might think you're food and come closer instead.
records.en_auxiliary: I've heard that it's no use playing dead. They might think you're food and come closer instead.
records.en: I've heard playing dead doesn't work.<CR>A bear might think you're food and come closer instead.

records.jp: 刺激しないようにゆっくり立ち去るのが良いって
records.en_original: The best thing to do is to walk away slowly without provoking them.
records.en_auxiliary: The best thing to do is to walk away slowly without provoking them.
records.en: They say the best thing to do is back away slowly without provoking it.

records.jp: 私、熊に会ったら絶対パニくっちゃうよ。<CR>騒いでるうちに襲われそう……
records.en_original: I'd totally freak out if I ever saw one. I'd probably get mauled while I was yelling my head off...
records.en_auxiliary: I'd totally freak out if I ever saw one. I'd probably get mauled while I was yelling my head off...
records.en: I'd totally freak out if I ever saw one. I'd probably get<CR>mauled while I was yelling my head off...

records.jp: 今のうちに練習しとく？
records.en_original: Shall we practice a bit then while we can?
records.en_auxiliary: Shall we practice a bit then while we can?
records.en: Shall we practice a bit then while we can?

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: What?
records.en_auxiliary: What?
records.en: What?

records.jp: ……がおー！
records.en_original: Rawr!
records.en_auxiliary: Rawr!
records.en: Rawr!

records.jp: ……こころみたいなかわいい熊だったら<CR>襲われてもいいかな
records.en_original: If the bear were as cute as you, I think I wouldn't mind being mauled, actually.
records.en_auxiliary: If the bear were as cute as you, I think I wouldn't mind being mauled, actually.
records.en: If the bear were as cute as you, I think I wouldn't<CR>mind being mauled, actually.

records.jp: 練習にならないよそれじゃあ
records.en_original: This won't make for very good practice then...
records.en_auxiliary: This won't make for very good practice then...
records.en: This won't make for very good practice then...

records.jp: キャンプと言えばキャンプ飯だよね
records.en_original: The best part of camping was always the food, I think.
records.en_auxiliary: The best part of camping was always the food, I think.
records.en: The best part of camping was always the food, I think.

records.jp: お外で食べるご飯、おいしいよね。<CR>カレーとか、バーベキューとか……
records.en_original: Something about eating outdoors makes it so tasty. There's curry, barbeque...
records.en_auxiliary: Something about eating outdoors makes it so tasty. There's curry, barbeque...
records.en: Something about eating outdoors makes it<CR>so tasty. There's curry, barbeque...

records.jp: キャンプと言えばカレーってイメージあるよね。<CR>なんでだろ？
records.en_original: Curry was always my favorite. I wonder why it's so popular as a camping food?
records.en_auxiliary: Curry was always my favorite. I wonder why it's so popular as a camping food?
records.en: Curry is what comes to mind when I think of camping.<CR>I wonder why?

records.jp: 林間学校とかでもみんなでカレー作ってたけど
records.en_original: I remember we made curry as a group at summer camp too.
records.en_auxiliary: I remember we made curry as a group at summer camp too.
records.en: I remember we made curry as a group at summer camp too.

records.jp: んー……おいしいから？
records.en_original: Hmm... Because it tastes good?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Because it tastes good?
records.en: Hmm... Because it tastes good?

records.jp: いや、それは間違いなくそうなんだけど……
records.en_original: Well, obviously, but...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, obviously, but...
records.en: Well, obviously, but...

records.jp: あとは、お皿が一つで済むとか、<CR>煮込むから食中毒になりにくいとか……
records.en_original: Plus, you only need one play per person, and there's low chance of getting food poisoning since you boil it for so long.
records.en_auxiliary: Plus, you only need one play per person, and there's low chance of getting food poisoning since you boil it for so long.
records.en: Plus, you only need one plate,<CR>and simmering it makes food poisoning less likely...

records.jp: へー、そういう理由があったんだ
records.en_original: Huh, that all makes sense.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, that all makes sense.
records.en: Huh, that all makes sense.

records.jp: キャンプと言えばバーベキューだよね。<CR>いざやろうとすると準備とか大変そうだけど
records.en_original: Camp barbeque is the best, though I bet it takes a ton of prep.
records.en_auxiliary: Camp barbeque is the best, though I bet it takes a ton of prep.
records.en: Camp barbeque is the best,<CR>though I bet it takes a ton of prep.

records.jp: 道具とかはレンタルできるキャンプ場もあるし、<CR>意外と荷物も少ないよ
records.en_original: There are some camp sites that rent out gear, so you don't have to bring much with you.
records.en_auxiliary: There are some camp sites that rent out gear, so you don't have to bring much with you.
records.en: There are some camp sites that rent out gear, so you don't<CR>have to bring much with you.

records.jp: へえ、そうなんだ
records.en_original: Oh, huh.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, huh.
records.en: Oh, huh.

records.jp: ……って言っても、こころは食材だけで<CR>だいぶ荷物かさんじゃいそうじゃない？
records.en_original: Though it seems like you'd still have to pack a ton of ingredients.
records.en_auxiliary: Though it seems like you'd still have to pack a ton of ingredients.
records.en: Though it seems like you'd still<CR>have to pack a ton of ingredients.

records.jp: それは……否定できないかも
records.en_original: Well... I guess I can't deny that.
records.en_auxiliary: Well... I guess I can't deny that.
records.en: Well... I guess I can't deny that.

records.jp: こころ、結構キャンプ詳しいね？
records.en_original: You seem to know a lot about camping, Kokoro.
records.en_auxiliary: You seem to know a lot about camping, Kokoro.
records.en: You seem to know a lot about camping, Kokoro.

records.jp: お父さんがそういうの好きで。<CR>ちっちゃい頃はよく山に連れてかれてたりしたよ
records.en_original: My dad really liked the outdoors. He would take me to the mountains pretty often when I was a kid.
records.en_auxiliary: My dad really liked the outdoors. He would take me to the mountains pretty often when I was a kid.
records.en: Dad liked that sort of thing.<CR>When I was little, he often took me into the mountains.

records.jp: 食材が現地調達の時もあって……
records.en_original: Sometimes, we had to catch our food while we were there.
records.en_auxiliary: Sometimes, we had to catch our food while we were there.
records.en: Sometimes, we had to catch our food while we were there.

records.jp: 魚釣ったりってこと？
records.en_original: Like fishing in mountain streams or something?
records.en_auxiliary: Like fishing in mountain streams or something?
records.en: Like fishing in mountain streams or something?

records.jp: うん。それもあるし……。<CR>あとは、イノシシとか
records.en_original: Mmhm. That too. We also hunted for boars.
records.en_auxiliary: Mmhm. That too. We also hunted for boars.
records.en: Yes, that too...<CR>And wild boar.

records.jp: イノシシ！？　どうやって！？
records.en_original: Boars?! How?!
records.en_auxiliary: Boars?! How?!
records.en: Boars?! How?!

records.jp: 猟銃で、ばきゅん
records.en_original: With a rifle. Bang.
records.en_auxiliary: With a rifle. Bang.
records.en: With a rifle. Bang.

records.jp: 現地調達のレベル高いな……
records.en_original: That adds a whole new meaning to eating local...
records.en_auxiliary: That adds a whole new meaning to eating local...
records.en: That adds a whole new meaning to eating local...

records.jp: 私には無理だなあ。<CR>普通に食材持参のキャンプがいいよ
records.en_original: No way I'd be able to do that. I'll just stick with bringing ingredients with me.
records.en_auxiliary: No way I'd be able to do that. I'll just stick with bringing ingredients with me.
records.en: That would be impossible for me.<CR>I'd rather just go camping and bring the ingredients.

records.jp: うん……それもわかる。<CR>市販の普通のお肉の方がクセがなくて食べやすいし
records.en_original: Yeah... I understand. Meat sold at the market is usually less gamey and easier to eat.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah... I understand. Meat sold at the market is usually less gamey and easier to eat.
records.en: Yes... I understand that too. Ordinary store-bought meat<CR>has less of a distinctive flavor and is easier to eat.

records.jp: 味の問題ではないけどね……
records.en_original: I didn't mean because of the taste...
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't mean because of the taste...
records.en: I didn't mean because of the taste...

records.jp: ずいぶんワイルドな人なんだね、こころのお父さん……
records.en_original: Sounds like your dad is pretty wild...
records.en_auxiliary: Sounds like your dad is pretty wild...
records.en: Sounds like your dad is pretty wild...

records.jp: うん。<CR>ちょっと変なところもあるけど、でも自慢のお父さん
records.en_original: Yeah. He may be a little different, but I was always proud of my dad.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. He may be a little different, but I was always proud of my dad.
records.en: Yeah.<CR>He's a little strange sometimes, but I'm proud of Dad.

records.jp: ……ふふ、そっか
records.en_original: Hehe, I see.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, I see.
records.en: Hehe, I see.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
